mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 3.8% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 3.8%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing slowdowns signal weakening economic activity, leading to negative forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential construction (HOUST) signals a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced business investment and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 3.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as both supply and labor market conditions deteriorate, leading to negative forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
